newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court dismisses Textilwerke challenge to state aid decision.
newsitem.headline: Court dismisses Textilwerke challenge to state aid decision.

text.p: The European Court of Justice upheld on Thursday a European Commission decision that monies given to Textilwerke Deggendorf Gmbh (TWD) by Germany constituted illegal state aid.
The Commission found the aid illegal because there had been no prior notification and because the aid was incompatible with the Community fibre and yarn aid code.

TWD challenged a ruling from the Court of First Instance which found the Commission did have the authority to block further grants of aid to the textile manufacturer until such time as the first illegal aid had been paid back.

TWD argued the Court of First Instance erred in law when it accepted the Commission decision without properly scrutinizing the langauge of the Commission's decision and because it found the Commission acted within its powers.
The court rejected these pleas along with additional arguments that the Commission abused its powers and offended the principle of proportionality.
